newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Cebu Shipyard changes name, adds facilities.
newsitem.headline: Cebu Shipyard changes name, adds facilities.

text.p: Cebu Shipyard and Engineering Works Inc said on Friday it will be renamed Keppel Cebu Shipyard and Engineering Inc to capitalise on the name of its parent firm, Keppel Corp.
It is upgrading its facilities which will include a new 120-metre wharf and other equipment to enable the company to undertake bigger and more complex repair jobs.
The proposed name change will be submitted on June 13 to shareholders for approval.
Cebu Shipyard said it is the largest and most comprehensive ship care facility in the Visayas region in central Philippines.
Currently, it has a 210-metre drydock capable of accommodating vessels of up to 35,000 dead weight tonnes which can undetake repair, conversion and construction of vessels.
